rounds.text: Sharda Ispat Ltd trades at a modest P/E of 14.2x and a price-to-book ratio of 1.35x, which compares favourably against sector benchmarks [E1, E2, E7]. Long-term compounding demonstrates robust quality, featuring 10-year profit growth of 29% and a strong median 10-year return on equity of 18% [E18, E25]. Recent financial performance displays exceptional acceleration, highlighted by a quarterly operating margin expansion of 5 percentage points to 9% in March 2026 and year-over-year net profit surging by 335% [E30, E62]. Valuation metrics provide a substantial margin of safety, with a discounted cash flow intrinsic value estimate reaching Rs 480 per share compared to the market price of Rs 174 [E42, E43]. Furthermore, the reverse DCF implies that the current market price only factors in a modest 4.0% earnings growth, drastically underestimating the business's fundamental trajectory [E44]. Conceded: the twelve-month price return sits at -45.0% with the stock trading below both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E47, E49].
